source.description: Classify one structured event using the following public policy. Critical means risk is TRUE or action is approve; critical cases require deny. Unknown external: risk UNKNOWN in context partner returns uncertain. Unknown risk otherwise prefers review at priority 90. Trusted means role is guest outside context partner; a trusted change prefers allow at priority 80. Action export in context partner prefers deny at priority 70. Role analyst or context sandbox prefers review at priority 40. Trusted cases forbid review. All other declared roles prefer allow at priority 1. Required labels override preferences. Abstention or conflicting required labels returns uncertain. Forbidden labels are removed; the remaining highest-priority preference wins.
requirements: Critical means risk is TRUE or action is approve; critical cases require deny.
Unknown external: risk UNKNOWN in context partner returns uncertain.
Unknown risk otherwise prefers review at priority 90.
Trusted means role is guest outside context partner; a trusted change prefers allow at priority 80.
Action export in context partner prefers deny at priority 70.
Role analyst or context sandbox prefers review at priority 40.
All other declared roles prefer allow at priority 1.
Required labels override preferences. Abstention or conflicting required labels returns uncertain. Forbidden labels are removed; the remaining highest-priority preference wins.
forbidden_shortcuts: Use every field named by a relevant rule.

repairs.original_source:
predicate Critical(event):
    (event.risk == TRUE) or (event.action == approve)

predicate Trusted(event):
    (event.role == guest) and (event.context != partner)

predicate UnknownExternal(event):
    (event.risk == UNKNOWN) and (event.context == partner)

rule CriticalCase:
    when Critical(event)
    then require label = deny

rule UnknownExternalCase:
    when UnknownExternal(event)
    then abstain

rule UnknownRisk:
    when (event.risk == UNKNOWN) and (not (UnknownExternal(event)))
    then prefer label = review priority 90

rule TrustedChange:
    when Trusted(event)
    then prefer label = allow priority 80, forbid label = review

rule ExportInPartner:
    when (event.action == export) and (event.context == partner)
    then prefer label = deny priority 70

rule AnalystOrSandbox:
    when (event.role == analyst) or (event.context == sandbox)
    then prefer label = review priority 40

rule OtherRoles:
    when ((event.role != guest) and (event.role != analyst)) and (event.role != admin)
    then prefer label = allow priority 1

    then prefer label = review priority 90

rule TrustedChange:
    when Trusted(event)
    then prefer label = allow priority 80, forbid label = review

rule ExportInPartner:
    when (event.action == export) and (event.context == partner)
    then prefer label = deny priority 70

rule AnalystOrSandbox:
    when (event.role == analyst) or (event.context == sandbox)
    then prefer label = review priority 40

rule OtherDeclaredRoles:

deployment_description: Classify one structured event using the supplied compiled instructions. The allowed outputs are allow, deny, review, uncertain. These names are arbitrary symbols, so do not infer their meaning. Copy the output stated by the matching compiled instruction.
